note: Measured, not aspirational. On 2026-08-21, after the in-place unescape and bidi-reorder scan views landed, the shipped engine (configs/default-rules.json + the default detector registry) scored 38/39 = 97.4359% detection and 5/21 = 23.8095% false positives on this corpus. The floor is that detection rate rounded DOWN to 4dp and the ceiling that FP rate rounded UP to 4dp, so the gate cannot fail against the run that set it -- and nothing looser: one more missed malicious case takes detection to 37/39 = 94.87% (fails), one more quarantined benign case takes FP to 6/21 = 28.57% (fails). The single missed case is encoded-plus-form, recorded as a known_gap: '+'-as-space form encoding is a live bypass that PASSES at 0.70. The detection floor is deliberately NOT 1.0 -- it was briefly, and that was misleading, because a same-class bypass was passing outside the corpus. A gate that reads 100% while a known bypass ships is worse than an honest 97.44%. The five false positives are also recorded gaps in manifest.json -- the ceiling exists to stop them growing, not to bless them. Move these only after measuring a real change, and say so in CHANGELOG.md. Tightening them is the point; loosening them to make a red build green is how a gate stops meaning anything.
